item.title: Python for AI Development by EduXpress
item.description: Your world powered by Python.
item.content:encoded: Step into new tech frontiers armed with the unmatched customization and power of Python, the star of our latest Tech Book Bundle with EduXpress. Pay what you want for a curated 25-eBook library that can help transform your perspective on modern tech. Discover fundamental topics like AI Development with Python, a visual deep dive into the basics of Python and AI, Large Language Models with Python, and everything else you need to dip your toes into programming. Plus, a portion of your purchase helps support the Python Foundation.

item.title: Python Mastery by Pragmatic Programmers
item.description: Python taught by developers for developers.
item.content:encoded: Go from a novice Python user to a programming mastermind with a curated library of books by Pragmatic Programmers! Learn practical, real-world problem-solving built upon flexibility, proven theories, and techniques rooted in longevity, not temporary trends, from books like Practical Programming, Fourth Edition and A Common-Sense Guide to Data Structures and Algorithms in Python, Vol. 2. Pay what you want for the ultimate Python library by Pragmatic Programmers and help support Save the Children with your purchase.

item.title: Rick and Morty Forever! The Grand Finale Bundle by Oni Press
item.description: Wubba lubba dub dub!
item.content:encoded: Dive into the Rick and Morty multiverse (Mortyverse??) with this giant bundle of every Rick and Morty comic series from Oni Press! Start with the main series beginning with Rick and Morty Vol. 1. Or get weird with Interdimensional Wrestling in Rick and Morty: Ricklemania, survive Purgatory in Rick and Morty: Go to Hell, and unravel a bizarre conspiracy in Rick and Morty: Meeseeks, P.I.! We’ve even got both volumes of Rick and Morty: The Manga and the entire crossover series Rick and Morty vs. Dungeons & Dragons II! Enjoy out-of-this-world adventure and side-splitting comedy in this bundle of Rick and Morty comic classics! Pay what you want and support Comic Books 4 Kids!

item.title: Data Science by O'Reilly
item.description: Demystify data science with elite eBooks
item.content:encoded: Pay what you want for a complete data science developer bundle by O’Reilly and kickstart your tech journey with expert-led lessons. This expert-led curriculum is designed to help you build a strong foundation in Python, AWS, Google Cloud, and other essential data science tools. Start learning with core courses like Data Contracts, AI-Ready Data Blueprints, Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate Study Guide, and more. Get the expert advice and knowledge you seek and help support Code for America with your purchase!

item.title: Woodworking, Turning, and Carving: An Encore by Taunton Press / Abrams
item.description: Master a time-honored craft!
item.content:encoded: Embrace an analog lifestyle and learn a new skill with this bundle of woodworking how-to guides from Taunton Press! Learn the woodworking basics that will bring your wood-based ideas to life, whether it’s a new piece of furniture, a beautiful cabinet, or a set of expertly turned chair legs, with The Why & How of Woodworking: A Simple Approach to Making Meaningful Work! Build the perfect box with Taunton's Complete Illustrated Guide to Box Making! Turn your kitchen into the galley of your dreams with Bookcases, Cabinets & Built-Ins! Use your new skills to build whatever your home, office, or studio requires, and support BINC with your purchase of this bundle at the price of you choosing!

item.title: Blue Lock: The Perfect Shot Bundle by Kodansha
item.description: Become the world’s greatest football star
item.content:encoded: When Japan’s national football team ranked low at the 2018 World Cup, they knew something needed to be done. Enter Yoichi Isagi, the hero of Blue Lock, Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yusuke Nomura’s shonen manga series about a cutthroat football training program designed to create the best striker in the world! Now, you can get all currently published digital volumes of Blue Lock in one bundle, including volumes of the main series up to #38, redemption code for #39 on kodansha.us, and seven volumes of prequel miniseries Episode Nagi by Kota Sannomiya, Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yusuke Nomura! Dive into a manga series perfect for football fans and shonen readers alike! Get these manga ebooks now at the price of your choosing, and support BINC with your purchase!

item.title: Robotics & Automation Engineering Mastery Bundle by Packt
item.description: Make life easier with robotics & automation.
item.content:encoded: Level up your skills with a curated robotics and automation engineering bundle designed to get you up to speed on the hottest topics in tech. Learn how to turn your static house into a dynamic digital home with Advanced Smart Home Automation Solutions with Home Assistant, take your curiosity to the skies with Drone Development from Concept to Flight, or turn your curiosity about robots into tangible skills with Mastering ROS 2 for Robotics Programming. Pay what you want for elite tech ebooks and help support charity: water with your purchase!

item.title: The EC Archives: Tales From the Crypt and Other Stories by Dark Horse & EC Comics
item.description: Tales of terror from the EC Archives
item.content:encoded: Kick off your Halloween celebrations with a bundle of vintage fun courtesy of Dark Horse and EC Comics! Straight from the EC Archives come classic horror comic series like Shock SuspenStories, Terror Illustrated, The Vault of Horror, and the spooky anthology that inspired the iconic HBO show Tales from the Crypt! Get a taste of some creepy classics with this multi-volume bundle of vintage thrills sure to get you into the Halloween spirit! Grab this entire library if you dare at the price of your choosing, and support the Freedom to Read Foundation with your purchase!

item.title: IT Management Toolkit by Taylor & Francis
item.description: Become a leader in IT
item.content:encoded: Learn the skills and knowledge you need to lead in information technology with this bundle of elite courses from Taylor & Francis. Inside this 25+ curriculum, you’ll get expert insights from courses like Strategic IT Governance 2.0, Augmented Intelligence, Enterprise Architecture for Digital Business, and more. Deepen your understanding whether you’re a newer manager or a seasoned professional, and help support Every Child a Reader with your purchase!

item.title: Candela Obscura by Darrington Press & Friends
item.description: Get The Descent, The Beast in the Binding and more!
item.content:encoded:
Immerse yourself in paranormal mysteries with this bundle of Darrington Press’s Candela Obscura TTRPG ebooks! Enter the Fairelands and join a secret society of the occult with the Candela Obscura Core Rulebook, which includes detailed descriptions of the turn-of-the-century urban horror-fantasy setting, example assignments, and guides for preparing your own adventures! Kick off your campaign with collections of multi-session assignments like Horrors of the Fairelands, The Bleeding Edge, The Woman in Red, and more! Dive into a fully realized world of magick and mystery and give your next tabletop adventure the spooky edge it’s been missing! Grab this bundle of TTRPG books and resources for the price of your choosing, and support the Critical Role Foundation with your purchase!

Keys are redeemable through DriveThruRPG.

item.title: Urban Shadows Physical Collection
item.description: Survive the city of shadows
item.content:encoded:
Dive into the supernatural demimonde of Urban Shadows with this bundle of physical game accessories! Now you can level up your literal tabletop with a physical copy of Urban Shadows: Second Edition, a dice tray and pack of five pairs of dice engraved with the city’s four powerful political Circles, and a Master of Ceremonies screen to hide all the exciting twists and turns from prying eyes. Journey through a city where nothing is as it seems, and forces both mundane and supernatural vie for power over the skyline of shadow! Grab these Urban Shadows accessories at the price of your choosing, and support Tabletop Gaymers with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before December 31st, 2026.

item.title: Castles & Crusades RPG Experience
item.description: Create your own adventure
item.content:encoded: Journey through a fantasy world of your own making with this bundle of Castles & Crusades TTRPG rulebooks and resources! Learn the rules of the game and design your characters with the Players Handbook, populate your fantasy land with monsters, artifacts, treasure, and NPCs, and collect digital editions of the White and Black box sets, complete with their own storylines and adventures! Dive into a fantastical adventure of your own design with this giant bundle of Castles & Crusades! Get these TTRPG resources now at the price of your choosing, and support Children’s Miracle Network with your purchase!

item.title: The Dynamite Trick-or-Treat Bundle by Dynamite
item.description: A Dynamite Halloween treat
item.content:encoded:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Celebrate the spooky season with this giant bundle of Halloween one-shots and horror series from Dynamite! Watch Ash Williams attempt to hold down a job while battling legions of Deadites in Ash vs. The Army of Darkness! Follow Vampirella on her hunt for a terrifying serial killer in Vampirella Halloween Horror! Celebrate the Festival of the Dead with Red Sonja and solve an outer space mystery with Bette Page in the heroines’ Halloween One-Shots! Get up to 98 comics in this trick-or-treat bundle—heavy on the treats! Pay what you want and support the Hero Initiative!

item.title: Java by Apress
item.description: Find your groove with Java by Apress.
item.content:encoded: Level up your tech skills before fall takes form with our latest Java Mastery Bundle by Apress. Flip the script on your job prospects and learn how to speak standard languages used by computer experts, create efficient agentic assistants, and more with approachable lessons like Pro Spring Boot 4: An Authoritative Guide with Best Practices and Go for Java Programmers: Learn Google's Go Programming Language. Start a new career in tech or sharpen your existing toolset, and help support No Kid Hungry with your purchase.

item.title: Best-Sellers of Amigurumi by Meteoor Books
item.description: Craft an amigurumi menagerie
item.content:encoded: Brighten every shelf, desk, and corner of your home with adorable amigurumi! This craft ebook bundle from Meteoor Books and Amigurumi.com brings you step-by-step patterns for the sweetest crochet creations from whimsical gnomes and magical creatures to endangered animals and forest friends. You'll even find full wardrobes of miniature outfits for four lovable animal friends. This bundle includes 24 ebooks of amigurumi patterns suitable for beginner and intermediate crafters, so get them now at the price of your choice, and support your favorite charity with your purchase!

item.title: DIY Halloween Displays and Holiday Gifts
item.description: Make it happen with DIY tech skills!
item.content:encoded: Unlock an epic collection of Make: ebooks with the all-new DIY Electronics Gadgets, Games, and More Bundle! Start your DIY journey with the Make: Encyclopedia of Electronic Components v1-3, a series of beginner-level reference resources designed to educate newcomers and experienced DIY enthusiasts alike. Or actualize your dreams of creating a mechanical companion with Make: Robotic Arms. Pay what you want for everything you need to build your own DIY tech and help support the Electronic Frontier Foundation with your purchase!

item.title: Celebrating 100 Years of Mindfulness, Peace, and Compassion: The Essential Thich Nhat Hanh Collection
item.description: A century of self care
item.content:encoded: On what would be globally influential spiritual activist Thich Nhat Hanh’s 100th Birthday, celebrate a century of mindfulness and peace with this collection of his essential books! Turn suffering into joy with No Mud, No Lotus. Learn key Buddhist mindfulness practices with Interbeing, 4th Edition and The Mindfulness Survival Kit. Content yourself with living in the moment with Happiness. Learn to live a more grounded, compassionate lifestyle with all of these books and more, included in this bundle at the price of your choice! Pay what you want and support the Thich Nhat Hanh Foundation with your purchase!

item.title: Excel by Wiley
item.description: Excel-erate your output with Microsoft 365
item.content:encoded: Ready to woo your team with the sharpest Excel skills in the office? We’ve got you covered with an approachable bundle of ebooks on Excel and the greater Microsoft 365 suite! Jam‑packed with titles from the iconic For Dummies series like Microsoft 365 Excel Formulas & Functions For Dummies, 7th Edition and Excel Data Analysis For Dummies, 5th Edition, this amazing bundle by Wiley covers a wide range of beginner and intermediate topics to help meet you at your existing skill level. Experience Excel’s everyday power of simple data organization, powerful calculations, and more while helping to support Kiss the Ground when you learn with Humble Bundle.

item.title: Gamer's Kitchen Cookbooks by Insight Editions
item.description: Games have never looked so delicious
item.content:encoded: Cook your way through your favorite games with this bundle of official and unofficial video game recipe books! Fry up tasty street food and mix some criminally delicious cocktails with An Unofficial Grand Theft Auto Cookbook! Fill up on sweetrolls and brew an apple cabbage stew any tavern keeper would envy with The Elder Scrolls: The Official Cookbook! Quench your thirst with the Wasteland-inspired libations in Fallout: The Official Drinks Book! Throw a gamer dinner party or cook up a multi-course meal for one with the 27 recipe books included in this collection! Grab them now at the price of your choice, and support NatureBridge with your purchase!

item.title: Cybersecurity Month 2026 by O'Reilly
item.description: Fortify your digital worlds with elite cybersecurity.
item.content:encoded: Online scams and malware are everywhere in 2026—what are you doing to protect yourself? Prevent security breaches before they happen with the techniques and tools from the Humble Tech Book Bundle: Cybersecurity Month by O’Reilly. Top titles from this curated library include Learning Cloud Security and Software Supply Chain Security. Learn software supply chain security and DevSecOps, build an original cyber risk management program, and more. Pay what you want to gain essential digital defense skills and help support Code for America with your purchase.

item.title: Gatchaman and Speed Racer by Mad Cave Studios
item.description: Catch up with Speed Racer & friends!
item.content:encoded: Dive into an all‑new interpretation of Tatsuo Yoshida’s classic manga series, Speed Racer, with our latest comics bundle! Follow the adventures of Speed, Trixie, Pops, Spritle, and Chim Chim as they race to save the day in the iconic symbol of speed and gadgetry—the Mach Five. Discover the high‑speed action of this timeless franchise! And, if that’s not enough adventure for you, we’ve included the iconic Gatchaman series for the ultimate teamup! Both legendary series are in one awesome bundle—plus, your purchase helps support the Make‑A‑Wish Foundation.
